lines.trans: Hello everyone. I came by to watch today's shoot.
What is the matter?
Now that the moment is here, I don't know what to do anymore...
Simply put ecstasy first. If you face it just as you are, you will be fine.
Still, taking that very first step is hard, isn't it? It was the same for me.
Then how did you manage to get past it?
A sign comes to you.
For everyone, when it's truly time to take a step forward, a notice arrives saying now is the moment.
Then... right now isn't that moment, is it?
Perhaps so. The sign surely waits close to despair.

meanings.note: Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

examples.text: おかえりなさい。新作の構想はどうです？

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.
Asks about condition, outcome (どうだった), or what happened (どうしましたか).
Polite sentence-ending counterpart of plain だ.

cells: ではありません / じゃありません

meanings.note: Can stand at the head of a sentence without a particle ('right now').
In casual speech, それ plus は often fuses into そりゃ ('well, as for that / of course').
Interrogative pronoun for place.
Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.

meanings.en: short casual form of じゃあ / では
meanings.note: Brisk spoken transition before taking the next step.
Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.

meanings.en: that (near the listener or just mentioned)
meanings.note: Must always precede a noun (その椅子 'that chair').
Ichidan verb.

examples.text: もう少しよく考えてみます。
examples.trans: I'll think about it a little more carefully.

meanings.note: Ichidan verb: blunt imperative 見ろ ('look!') is rough command speech.

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.
Irregular verb: くる -> きます -> きました.
All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.
Attaches to the irrealis (a-stem) of godan verbs.

examples.trans: I was called by the teacher.

meanings.note: Marks the presence of a person (責任者はいるか) or follows て-form (often contracted to てる/てます in speech).

meanings.note: Expresses change of state, or in polite customer service (になります) states an arrangement or price total.

examples.trans: That comes to one thousand yen.

meanings.note: Irregular i-adjective whose past/conditional stems use よ- (よかったら).

examples.text: よかったら来てください。

meanings.note: Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.

examples.text: 日本語が少し分かります。

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.note: Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.

meanings.en: whichever (after question word); or something like
meanings.note: After どれ (どれでも) means 'any one at all'; after a noun (店でも) suggests an example ('a shop or something').

examples.text: いつでも来てください。
お茶でも飲みませんか。
examples.trans: Won't you have tea or something?
